description:
We are Team Space Nova from India. We are building Flash Drought Early Warning - a NASA-powered system for laterite farms.

Our team is from a drought-prone area. We use NASA SMAP, MODIS, and GPM data to predict flash drought 15 days early.

Mission: Save farmers with NASA data.

Local Event: Kharagpur - In-person on Nov 14-15.
summary: CropSwitch is a data-driven decision-support website by Team Space Nova for the NASA Space Apps Challenge – Adapting Farms with NASA Data. It uses NASA Earth observations – SMAP for soil moisture, GPM IMERG for rainfall, Landsat for crop health (NDVI), and NASA POWER for temperature – combined with USDA agricultural data, to help farmers across all 50 US states understand climate, water, and soil conditions. Farmers can compare crop rotations, evaluate water requirements and soil benefits, and plan more resilient growing seasons. By turning complex satellite data into simple, accessible insights, CropSwitch supports sustainable farming, better resource management, and climate-resilient decisions.
details:
CropSwitch is a web-based agricultural decision-support platform by Team Space Nova that helps farmers across all 50 US states make informed crop rotation and seasonal farming decisions using NASA Earth observation data and USDA agricultural statistics.

HOW IT WORKS

  1. LAND SELECTION: Farmers select their state, county, and farm area to explore relevant conditions.
  2. ENVIRONMENTAL ANALYSIS: The platform combines climate, rainfall, soil moisture, vegetation (NDVI), and terrain data to give a complete picture of farming conditions.
  3. CROP ROTATION COMPARISON: Farmers can compare crop options based on water requirements, soil benefits, nitrogen fixation, and drought / flood risk.
  4. SEASONAL PLANNING: The system suggests suitable crops, cover crops, and planting schedules for a more resilient season.

DATA SOURCES – 7 NASA DATASETS

  • • NASA POWER - Climate, temperature and meteorological data
  • • SMAP (SPL3SMP) – Soil moisture
  • • GPM / IMERG - Precipitation / rainfall
  • • NDVI – Crop health at 30 m resolution
  • • SRTM - Terrain / Elevation
  • • USDA NASS QuickStats - Crop Production / Yield
  • • USDA NASS QuickStats - Crop Income / Cash Receipts

TOOLS USED

Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the frontend; Python for data processing; NASA API integration (NASA POWER API + AppEEARS API); and CSV / GeoJSON for datasets. Hosted as a responsive web app for desktop and mobile.

BENEFITS & IMPACT

Farmers can save water, reduce crop failure risk, improve soil health, and choose climate-resilient rotations. By turning complex satellite data into simple, visual insights, CropSwitch supports sustainable farming and better resource management, especially for small and medium farmers facing climate change.

WHAT MAKES IT CREATIVE

Instead of showing raw satellite maps, CropSwitch translates 5 different NASA datasets into one simple question for farmers: "What should I plant next, and why?" – with water, soil, and risk comparison in one place.

FACTORS CONSIDERED

We considered water availability, soil health, climate variability, ease of use for non-technical farmers, and accessibility on low-bandwidth mobile devices.
